items.headline: Florida State's Norvell downplays moving truck post, focused on Alabama
items.description: Florida State coach Mike Norvell said he had no idea a social media post showing a box truck outside his home went viral until he was asked about it during his Wednesday news conference, saying his entire focus has been on preparing to play at Alabama.

items.headline: Ethan Pritchard was shot in the head, then 'a miracle' happened
items.description: The Florida State linebacker spent a month in a coma. It wasn't clear he'd ever wake up. Now, he's looking to play football again.
